core_evidence.rationale: Exact commit/tree were frozen, re-observed, bound into the permit, capture manifest and recovery comparison.
Git/Python/repository/local destinations were checked before the bounded run and missing Python initially blocked execution.
A narrow human-authorized run intent was materialized, but conflicting or multi-party intent was not tested.
A single-use bounded permit constrained effects; contested authority, delegation and external standing were not tested.
Human, protocol, GitHub evidence and local executor shared one frozen frontier, but no independent external participant or conflict resolution occurred.
Execution failed closed on environment prerequisites and would fail on frontier mismatch; permitted effects were explicitly bounded.
Capture, bundle verification, disposable recovery, fsck and exact recovered commit/tree were recorded as canonical receipts.

pilot_002.reason: Adds external participant input, plurality, contestability and scoped disclosure while keeping execution effects bounded and human-gated.
